# Plans and Pricing

Silo Workspace is priced per user, per year. Every tier includes the full platform. The difference between tiers is the coverage provided by the Silo Managed Attribution Network. Choose one region, two regions, or all regions.

## Silo Workspace capabilities

### Silo Workspace

- Library of desktop, messaging, and productivity apps
- Silo for Research browser
- Configurable browser profiles
- Persistent or single use browsing data
- Multi-language input and output

### Regions

- North America
- Europe
- Central and South America
- Asia-Pacific
- Africa and Middle East
- Dark web
- Rapid response nodes

### Nexus AI

- Live content capture
- Active annotations
- Source-grounded responses
- Multiple conversation threads
- Curated prompt library
- Identity-shielded queries
- No prompt retention for model training
- Encrypted, immutable conversation logs

### Productivity Tools

- Screenshot and annotation
- Out-of-band translation
- Automated collection utility
- Multi-site search
- Chrome extension management
- Developer tools
- Encrypted personal and shared storage
- Case management

### Organizational Governance & Oversight

- Silo is built with policy enforcement, access controls, audibility, and integration APIs to support your mission. [Learn more](https://authentic8.com/admin/)

## Mask, protect, accelerate, and manage your digital investigations

Silo places you in-region and in control
